## P8.6-A — the title-screen music: why the STREAM module streams nothing after case 7 under poll; fix; W142 measured (2026-10-03, 16:47–17:40, ≈53 min)

HEAD at START `b510fe5` (`git -P log --oneline -n 1` → `b510fe5 Gate S3 (poll on the P8.4-A binary): …`), unchanged at the end. No commits. OLD read-only (its `game_files/` read by the legs as `run_leg.py` defaults; `old_cb.log` read; no OLD binary run). Sole BUILDER (`build_dev1..4.log` + `build_test.log`: `build_rc=0`, `grep -c warning:` → `0` each; `cmake_cfg{,2}.out` `cfg_rc=0`). The pcsx2-debug tools WERE used (five EE breakpoints — 0x1e65b8, 0x1e1ca8, 0x1e62bc, 0x1e1500, 0x2ad8e0 — `clear_all_breakpoints` run; `list_breakpoints` before I started showed none; the reference is left paused at `beginning_splash.p2s` + a run to 0x2ad8e0). **Disclosures:** (1) one `python3 - <<EOF` stdin snippet edited `ee_bootstrap.cpp` (the first census wiring) before I switched to file helpers (`edit_head.py`, `apply_fix.py`, `edit_rootpin.py`, `edit_dlog.py`, `edit_test_census.py`, all under the work dir); (2) a transient `git add -N` + `git reset` on the test file to include it in a diff (staging touched for one second, nothing committed); (3) **the fix was applied to `engine/sif/hle/sce_sif.{h,cpp}` (NOT an owned path) for the measurement and REVERTED with `git checkout -- …` before the final build/suite** — the landed tree carries only owned paths (`git status --short` below).

**Headline.** The silence is NOT the module's: the title never asks it to stream. The title's ONE-SHOT music init runs at the splash (boot case 1, boundary 113): `FUN_001E6280` loads MUSIC.MH and calls `FUN_001E65B8` for the three music objects; each queries the module's free IOP memory (cmd 45 + the BLOCKING `Ship(0)`) and reads the answer from the client's processed status copy right after the call (`FUN_002AD8B8` → `FUN_001E3308(0, sp)` → `0x309b9c`), opening a stream pair (cmd 13, ring 0x40000) only if `need(0x40000) < free`. Retail libkernl's blocking `sceSifCallRpc` runs the end function (the reply processor `FUN_001e6968 → FUN_001e1f48` that fills the copy) BEFORE returning; NEW's `SceSif::CallRpc` defers every end function to the boundary duty, so the copy reads **0** three times and no pair opens — at the case-7 edge there is nothing to start. Reference (PCSX2): `free = 0x108800`, the three pairs open at case 1. With the blocking-mode rule (poll only) the music plays: `snd_kon=8 snd_active=4`, first non-silent window **W191** (edge b1134; OLD W142 at edge b852 — the same onset phase), the exact title-music command signature, the reference's slot table. **The fix is measured but NOT landed: it lives in `engine/sif` (outside the owned paths) — `RESULT: BLOCKED`.** `boundary` bit-identical with and without it.

## P8.9-A — BUG-072 fixed in the recompiler (no function entry at a branch delay slot; a case for every externally-entered address); shards regenerated; f57292/f59991 reach 600 frames (2026-10-03, 22:46–00:58, ≈132 min; the 80-min budget was passed by the two full-suite runs + the Release rebuild)

HEAD at START `8b348ee` (`git rev-parse --short HEAD`), `git status --short` empty; no `REVIEW.md`. No commits. OLD read-only (its ELF read by the tool; `OLD/tests/recompiler_v2/fixture.h` READ for the fixture shape; no OLD binary run, no OLD edit). Work dir `int_work/p89a/` (`PROGRESS.md`, `fn_diff.py`, logs; 3.6 MB). Every helper was a file run with `python3 -u`; no helper left running; no pcsx2 tools used.

**Headline.** Both rules landed in NEW's recompiler (`tools/recompiler_v2/recompiler_tool/discovery/functions.cpp`): (1) a WEAK seed (prologue pattern / data pointer / code-constructed pointer) whose address is the delay slot of the preceding branch/jump is never a function start — the slot executes with its transfer on both paths, so a function cannot begin there; a STRONG seed there (jal / table / ELF entry) is kept (the hardware starts there when called) and reported; (2) every address flow can enter from outside a function — a branch's fall-through `pc+8`, a jal/jalr return site, an external jump-table target — is a leader of the function that CONTAINS it, so the emitted `switch (addr)` carries its case (before, `ft < fn.end` only recorded it when inside the site's own function — exactly the missing `case 0x178480`). Regenerated by the script (three bounded runs byte-identical): `[v2] discovered 8807 functions, 177 jump-table sites, 8848 unreached gap words`, `[v2] delay-slot rule: 12 weak seed(s) rejected, 1 strong entry in a delay slot`. The unit pin was RED on the frozen shards (`-16` per fall-through call) and is GREEN now; both anchors run to 600 frames (`frames=600 finalized=1 park=none`). Suite: run 1 `99% … 1 failed of 398` (the stale 8819 function-count pin in `test_dispatch_table.cpp`, updated to 8807); run 2 ALONE after the Release rebuild quoted under Tests.

## P8.12-A — the GS pipeline on its own thread (plan row 6.3): DrawIR queue + consumer thread; frames byte-identical; play-mode throughput (2026-10-04, 03:21–04:25, ≈ 64 min incl. the 17-min suite)

HEAD at START `431ef54` (`git rev-parse --short HEAD` → `431ef54`). No commits. OLD read-only (its anchor `save_states/artdet_f37152.ps2st` and `game_files/` read by `verify/run_leg.py`; nothing written under OLD). Builder of `build/` and `build-release/`; every build window announced in `PROGRESS.md` and opened only with the sibling P8.12-B's last line a `LEG CLOSED` (its legs run from its own `bin/` copies). The `verify/*` and `verify/attribution/*` modifications in `git status` are the sibling's (never touched here). No REVIEW.md existed at the time of writing.

**Headline.** Row 6.3's consumer thread is landed: `DrawIrThreadQueue` (a cross-thread DrawIR ring with a consumer thread that owns the GL context) behind Config `gs.queue = inline (default) | thread | pipelined`. `thread` runs in LOCKSTEP (each push returns consumed) and is byte-identical to `inline` by construction — pinned by `RootGsQueueThreadIdentical` (coldboot 130 + artdet 60, five lanes, `pin=IDENTICAL`). The pipelined form (the ring running a frame ahead, `max_depth=1482`) is −19 % wall in Debug / −9 % Release but **29/30 frames differ**, and the cause is named: the EE and the pipeline share ONE `VramImage` which the EE side settles (`SettleWrites` → `CommitDeposits`) before EVERY draw flush and writes per pixel at every transfer — the deposit/commit rule is interleaving-dependent. The throughput lever is therefore a page-granular VRAM-image barrier in `engine/gs/state`+`xfer` (DP-25 option (b)), not the queue. Lockstep costs the hop (+8 % Debug artdet, +4 % play 240, +16 % Release) so the default stays `inline`; DP-25 written with the flip rule.

## P8.23-A — the title-screen footprint growth attributed and fixed (BUG-083); BUG-081 hypothesis tested; coldboot_attract runs to 6000 frames (2026-10-05, ≈ 60 min)

HEAD kept `d2fb425` (quoted at start: `d2fb425 Phase 8: P8.22-T the 13th leg coldboot_attract frozen …`; tree clean at start). No commits; OLD read-only (its sources and `game_files/` read, its binary never run); every edit inside the owned paths (`engine/gs/**`, `app/host/ee_bootstrap.cpp`, `tools/footprint_watch.py`, `tests/**`, docs). Work dir `int_work/p823a/` (`PROGRESS.md` with timestamps; helper `probe_words.py`; artefacts under `attr/`, `b81/`, `attract_new/`, `probes/`).

**Attribution (what grows).** The OLD probe `old_b2700.ps2st` (the title) restores under `--load-state` but does not resume (`restore.mhash` written, the THRD records relaunched into `ThreadRelauncher::WalkChain`, 0 frames in 50 s — the INT-P820B-NEW-BOUNDARY-IMAGE-NOT-RESUMABLE class), so the attribution ran on a Release coldboot leg (`attr/cb`, 2800 frames) under the new sampler `tools/footprint_watch.py` (vmmap footprint vs `frames.fhash` lines every 3 s): `170 925.4 MB → 209 2764.8 → 1133 3276.8 → 1280 5120.0 → 1927 6246.4 → 2020 8908.8 → 2366 11980.8 → 2431 14950.4 (peak 15257.6) → 2800 10547.2` — ≈ 1.5 MB/frame in the cutscene, **≈ 8.5 MB/frame on the title (f2246 → f2366: 10956.8 → 11980.8 MB)**, with ≈ 1.8 GB jumps at f209 / f1280 / f2020. `vmmap --summary` on the live process (`attr/cb_vmmap_summary_a.txt`): `MALLOC_LARGE 12.1G` virtual in 106 regions (1.8G resident, 5.7G swapped), every other region type < 300 MB (`IOAccelerator (graphics) 142.9M`) — host heap, not GL. `heap -s` (`attr/cb_heap.txt`): **one node of `1.25829e+07KB` (12 GiB)** among `121997 nodes … 13079833021 bytes` — a single container whose doublings are the jumps. `MallocStackLogging` (lite / malloc) crashes both builds at start (`=== fatal signal SIGSEGV ===`), so the node was read live: a second leg at f1320 → `heap -addresses 'non-object[500000000-]'` → `0xc88000000: non-object (3221225472 bytes)`; `lldb -p … memory read -s4 -fx` → 24-byte records `0x00030000 0x00098053 0x00000004 …` (Tag, path 3) … `0x00025407 0x00000000 0x879e8e98 0x819c909a 0x7b95949c 0x7490909e` (kind 7 = Image, reg 0x54 = HWREG, 16 image bytes) = the `RegisterOp` layout. **Owner: `RegisterOpStream gs_ops` in `app/host/ee_bootstrap.cpp` (the `gsops_hash`/`gsops.ohash` recorder) — `Push` appended every sink call to `ops_` for the whole leg while the leg reads only `Hash()`/`Count()`** (`gsops_ops=311656456` for 2800 frames × 24 B = 7.5 GB). Not the decode caches (L2 bounded 320 MiB / 16384, L1 evicted by range), not the GL pool (96 MiB / 128), not the DrawIR ring, not the targets.

**Fix.** `RegisterOpStream(bool retain_records = true)`: a hash-only stream folds the same FNV-1a chain and counts (`Count()` is a counter; `RetainsRecords()`, `RetainedBytes()`; `Clear()` releases storage); the leg constructs `RegisterOpStream gs_ops(/*retain_records=*/false)`; replay/test consumers of `Ops()` keep the retaining default. The hash is identical by construction (same bytes, same chain), so no lane moves — verified below. Census: `run.meta footprint=b60_mb,last_mb,peak_mb,final_mb,gsops_retained_bytes` (`task_info(TASK_VM_INFO).phys_footprint`, the number `vmmap --summary` prints) and `footprint_series=` (one sample per 60 boundaries, first 128).

**BUG-081 hypothesis test — REFUTED.** Release coldboot 2520 `--dump-frames` with the fix (`b81/`): `f2519.ppm` md5 `45eebd45dcd90d17de2af78182a39ed0` **= `verify/baseline/title_screen/new_coldboot_f2519_bcd30c2.ppm`** (byte-identical to the pre-fix reference); `title_regions.py`: `LOGO … yellow=(213,177, 65) n=23255 bright=0.182`, `ORB bright=0.098`, `OCEAN bright=0.472`; the live composition `f2519_drawn_0x70000.ppm`: `LOGO yellow=(219,183, 67) bright=0.620`, `ORB 0.303`, `OCEAN 0.536` — exactly P8.21-A's numbers. The growing footprint was not a decoded-texture generation and the live texel is unchanged; BUG-081 stays OPEN with its recorded next step.

**The 13th leg.** `run_leg.py --tree new --binary build-release/app/host/nativeee --anchor coldboot --frames 6000 --profile deterministic --timeout 3000 --stall-s 600` → **`run_leg: OK …/attract_new`**, `frames=6000 wall_ms=284520 finalized=1`, `footprint=b60_mb=79,last_mb=429,peak_mb=491,final_mb=429,gsops_retained_bytes=0` (series through the title `b1500:428 … b1740:436`, the attract `b4140:491`, the return `b5400:428 … b5940:434`; the sampler: `4100 384.0 → 4110 471.5 → 4529 484.8 → 5882 433.3`). Against the frozen baseline (`diff_legs.py --cross-engine --lanes frames,audio,mem`): `frames.fhash: FIRST DIVERGENT frame at key 69 … coalesced=2`, `audio.ahash: … line 143 (key 142)`, `mem.mhash: … line 1 (key 0)` — the same `69/142/0` as coldboot's S8 row (the same boot; no FMV pairing, as battery runs it). Probes: `probe_images.py --binary … --legs coldboot_attract` → `probe_images: OK` with `new_b1500 … hash 0xcef5236a4eb725f9 vsync_frame 1500`, `new_b2700 … 0x5f3d586bd81f7aca … 2700`, `new_b3780 … 0xa4b252fc201c0a1e … 3780`, `new_b4200 … 0x3db88fd2a14849d7 … 4200`, `new_b5400 … 0x694e30a9ee9b6e98 … 5400`; `score.pair_words` (`probe_words.py`): `b1500 RAM0=3907544 SPAD=1178`, `b2700 3931341/1173`, `b3780 3973720/1173`, `b4200 3992244/1619`, `b5400 4027189/1612`, **`outside_mask_words total=19838793 over 5 pairs`** (NEW's images sit at `vsync_frame == boundary` where OLD's are at `boundary + 530`: the DP-17 timeline class, the whole-image count). The probe leg (`--state-every 60`, 100 images) is byte-identical to the lanes-only leg on mem (`cmp` identical) and audio (identical) and frames (`diff … | grep -c '^<'` → `0`) — NEW's images perturb nothing (unlike OLD's, FREEZE.md).

  1. State: `fs+0xc` = BD-absolute START of the ring's current fill (`fs+0x2c`-relative for the file); `fs+0 & 0x40000` = ring valid; `fs+0 & 0x10000` = read pending; `cb {+8 base, +0xc cursor, +0x10 cap}`; the ring content once landed = `file[fs+0xc − fs+0x2c, +filled)`, `filled = min(eof − fs+0xc, cap)`.
  2. Hit (`0x40000` up and `fs+0xc ≤ pos` and `pos + size ≤ fs+0xc + filled`): seek the cursor to `base + (pos − fs+0xc)` and serve by the title's own copy-out (`cb vtbl+0x14`, `FUN_002b5dd8`: `memcpy` + cursor advance) with NO enqueue/DMA.
  3. Straddle (`0x40000` up, `pos` inside, `pos + size` past the end): copy the tail (`tail = fs+0xc + filled − pos`) by copy-out; if the remainder `size − tail < cap`: rewind the cursor to base, `fs+0xc = pos + tail`, `fs+0 |= 0x10000`, ONE enqueue of `min(eof − (pos + tail), cap)` to base, stage the remainder (`fs+0x18 = size − tail`, `fs+0x10 = dest + tail`) for the poll's copy-out (or copy out after the wait when the caller waits); else (remainder ≥ cap): copy the 64-B-aligned tail, read the rest DIRECT to `dest + aligned`, clear `0x40000`, `fs+0xc` untouched.
  4. Miss (`0x40000` down, `size < cap`): rewind, `fs+0xc = pos`, pending, ONE enqueue of `min(eof − pos, cap)` to base, stage `fs+0x18 = size / fs+0x10 = dest`, set `0x40000`. `size ≥ cap` or no stream: direct to dest (unchanged today).
  5. Epilogue: clear `0x40000` when the cursor reaches the ring's end.

the 13-scenario stability battery decide retirement acceptance. Frozen
references, masks and attribution remain unchanged.

  state/assembly remain.
- `GameLibraries::kSoundBankHeaders` enables the checked `.mh` reader at NTSC
  `0x2ab160`. Complete owned header storage is published through the existing
  allocation contract. Sample-file handles, sample residency and other STREAM
  operations remain.
- `hle/graphics/{graphics,graphics_buckets,graphics_bridge,graphics_service,
  strip_draw,material_state,frame_environment}.*`: typed geometry and ordered
  submission for the retail untransformed flat UI Strip at `0x1a9120`. The
  service captures complete source data before bypassing the producer, joins
  it to the actual bucket predecessor, and selects deferred frame walks by
  their root and generation. Unsupported and interior entries retain the
  complete original body. Empty strips retain their setup lifecycle.
- `app/host/graphics_output.*`, `ee_bootstrap.cpp`: common draw sequencing and
  resource completion, bindings, quiescence refusal for pending work, restore
  invalidation, and completed-work counters. FrameEnvironment owns full
  scanlines and ordinary Mix for this flat UI intent after checked frame

- `engine/dmac/chain_walker.*`: generic post-tag/first-tag/end notification and
  staged-feed flush for the migration boundary. `GsState::SubmitDrawIr`
  publishes a complete draw through shared sequence/resource ownership without
  parsing commands or changing register state. No DMA/VIF command fidelity
  was added.
- `verify/retirement_gate.py`, `gate_run.py`, `battery.py` and the cold-boot
  fixture runner enforce DT-11. The retirement checker reads actual repeated
  artifacts and measured scene pairing; score claims alone are insufficient.

No OLD implementation was transplanted or edited. Source contracts come from
TR commit `38d533d0033b48b5d6b49880c49f5eeeade0f38e`, especially `buckets.cpp`,
`draw2d.cpp`, `frame.cpp`, `materials.cpp`, `shadersettings.cpp` and the checked
NTSC bodies. No new configuration/environment flag, baseline, mask, attribution
or hardware state write was introduced. Math's additional helpers and Movie's
lifecycle prototype remain outside the enabled accepted bindings.

### Defects and focused verification

The ordered-slot test exposed an inline packet overtaking an older inbox
boundary. Enqueue now preserves that order. Inline and MTVU tests cover raw,
library and boundary crossings; the GS publication test covers shared sequence
and resource epochs.

The Strip audit exposed a depth conversion assumption: nearest rounding gave
`0x4f800000`, while the source EE/output policy requires `0x4f7fffff`. StripDraw
now converts runtime unsigned depth inside its explicit toward-zero scope,
restores caller rounding, and checks bounds/hash under all four caller modes.
The corrected independent generated-body audit checks 4,256 cases, 535,619
vertices and 439,742 triangles with zero differences.

Debug and Release build without warnings. Graphics/material/frame-guard tests,
the ordered migration tests and normal lints pass. The first GIF-only attract
preview preserves all 6,000 frame and 1,000 audio hashes, with 12,041,856 parser
bypasses. The enabled bank fixture preserves all 130 frame and 22 audio hashes;
the frame-120 memory difference remains visible as advisory.

A later frame-212 difference was isolated with a bank-enabled/Graphics-disabled
control. Graphics preserves that control's first 213 frame and 36 audio hashes,
with 152 completed bucket-24 draws in 19 ordered groups and zero delivery errors.
The difference from the bank-disabled preview is therefore not evidence of a
Graphics pixel defect. The depth correction is independently justified by its
numeric contract; it is not claimed as the cause of that pixel difference.
